local_conditions.materially_affects: Establishes that the business serves the area at all.

local_conditions.condition: Under NRS 116.3102 a Nevada community association may cause a vehicle to be removed when it is improperly parked on property owned or leased by the association, or on a road, street, alley or other thoroughfare within the community. 48 hours' notice is required except for fire hydrants, fire lanes, accessible spaces, or an imminent threat to health, safety or welfare.
local_conditions.materially_affects: Sets the boundary of what an association can actually do. A vehicle on the owner's own driveway is outside this power, which is the opposite of what the live page implies.

local_conditions.condition: Under NRS 116.31031, a fine for a violation not posing an imminent threat may not exceed $100 per violation or $1,000 per hearing, a hearing opportunity is required, and a violation uncured after 14 days may draw an additional fine for each subsequent 7-day period.
local_conditions.materially_affects: This is the real enforcement pressure — fines through a process with a cure window, not daily penalties and not towing from a driveway.

local_conditions.condition: NRS 116 applies to common-interest communities throughout Nevada, not to Henderson specifically.
local_conditions.materially_affects: Decisive for differentiation: a statutory regime shared by every sibling area cannot distinguish one location page from another.
